I was bored one day, and a friend of mine and I decided to race NSMBDS casually. Unfortunatelly, his game kept crashing so the race was never finished. Now, the next day, I decided to speedrun this game just to keep my mind away from my everyday obsession, mmm~

Now, I didn't actually had any knowledge in "speedrunner" strats for this run, nor was I intending to actually run *hard* with the speedrun. It was just a casual-like speedrun.

In fact, my mental notes were rather simple:
~Maintain fire Mario status + fire flower in item reserve (I know this is slower). And just go quick.
~Use W1-2 Secret, W2-3 Secret Path, W3-2 Secret Path, W5-2 Secret (which may have been slower due to having to face W5-4 Autoscroller), and 2nd bottom path in W6.
~For applicable bosses, first stomp (1000pts), then ground pound to finish them off.

Opinion:
I suppose this was a good run, considering I had saved at every single one of the save prompts I encountered. :P

Of course, I had died a bunch which costed at least 4 minutes total. Pffft, I've had at least 6 deaths this time, but considering how this was my first out-right attempt, no practice, haven't played in a year, it's pretty good.

# "I once thought this run was made of unobtainium." - me (paraphrased)

Over a fortnight greater than 10k attempts among a broken F key, I overcame and became the SECOND person ever and the FIRST person on emulator and in the USA to tie this insane-ass world record. This matches Cads' initial completion making it a tied world record and further eroding a (currently) 276 run way tie for 27s. This level cannot currently be further optimized with IL timing and ties the TAS. 

The IL may look elementary but it requires a total of ~16 frame perfect inputs to perform with only ONE FRAME to spare. One little slip up and your run is given a pink slip. This is due by the copious sum of corner boosts which each ideally save two frames, meaning you must hit all of them perfectly with one sub-optimal boost... assuming you're still on that fastest pace possible (which I probably was not). 

Greetz to Cads, Cirole, Koki, Catzee, and every other soul that motivated me.
